messages:
Priya: Heads-up — ran ember-7b-ptq canary vs structured-funcall suite. Non-stream compliance 93.8% (expected 98), streaming 84.2%. More trailing prose / mid-json splits.

deploy-bot: Canary c-91 deployed ember-7b-ptq @ commit 9b2d7f to /v1/struct-generate. Canary telemetry on.

Ben: Can you paste the raw streamed chunks we saw?

Priya: here's an exact stream capture (chunks separated by |):
{"action":"open","args":{"doc":"inference"}}|"Thanks, here's more context about the search results"|{"action":"click","args":{"id":42}}

Li: Oof — looks like the model emitted a JSON, then freeform text, then another JSON in same stream. Could be buffer flush boundary or model prompting behavior.

Sam: We rolled streaming flush from 640->384 tokens in commit 9b2d7f to improve p99 latency. Kernel patch kv-split also landed. Logs show split-rate jump around that commit.

Priya: Temp=0.0, top_p=0.0 in tests. Non-stream still lower than prod baseline; suspect PTQ variant plus kernel changes.

Ben: Regex heuristics are brittle. I'll prototype a stack-based incremental parser: scan bytes, track braces/brackets/quotes, harvest first balanced top-level JSON, then validate against expected schema keys.

Alex: Add heuristic: if multiple balanced objects appear, pick one containing required top-level key 'action' and correct args shape. If none, fall back to rescue truncation.

Priya: Rescue truncation (cut at depth==0) improved stream compliance from 84.2% -> 95.7% but introduced mapping glitches: duplicate keys merged incorrectly in 0.6% of cases.

qa-bot: Canary report: prod baseline funcall 98.1%; ember-7b-ptq non-stream 93.8%, stream 84.2%, stream+rescue 95.7% (arg-mapping regressions 0.6%).

Li: Proposal: For strict routes, disable streaming in canary until we root cause. Also add a 'soft accept' schema mode that tolerates trailing prose and emits structured warnings.

Ben: I'll push incremental parser PR with test vectors (EOD). It will prefer earliest valid JSON with required keys, and include a 'repair_score' header.

Sam: I'll add chunk-boundary telemetry (percent responses with mid-json flush). If split-rate >5% for canary, auto-rollback flag triggers.

Priya: Action items accepted: (1) disable streaming on strict canary routes (2) add tests with real stream captures to CI corpus (3) log raw captures to ephemeral S3 with trace IDs. Assign Ben/Sam/Alex. I'll draft a short incident note.

Ben: Will attach example traces to PR. Thanks.

Priya: Reconvene in 24h after new telemetry.
